summary: Iteration 5 polish verified. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass — POST /api/contact returns 200 with new schema (client_email_sent, owner_email_sent, email_error; old email_sent removed), persists all 4 languages (sr/en/ru/zh), validates missing fields and bad email format with 422, GET /api/contact returns most-recent-first with no _id leakage, and the background task correctly writes outcome to the DB record (verified: when SMTP fails in sandbox both booleans = false and email_error is non-null). Frontend: hero-title has computed CSS filter 'drop-shadow(rgba(0,0,0,0.95) 0px 6px 24px) drop-shadow(rgba(0,0,0,0.9) 0px 2px 6px)'. Form (data-testid=contact-form) and map (data-testid=contact-map) have equal bounding heights — 504.5px each (0px diff, well within 10px tolerance). New POZOVITE NAS <a data-testid=contact-call href='tel:+38162625500'> sits on the same row as contact-submit, innerText reads 'POZOVITE NAS' (uppercased via CSS text-transform). Language switcher updates the call button correctly: en→CALL US, ru→ПОЗВОНИТЕ НАМ, zh→致电我们, sr→POZOVITE NAS. End-to-end form submission triggers the sonner success toast 'Hvala! Poslali smo vam potvrdu na email.'

minor.issue: Gmail SMTP still rejects credentials with 535 BadCredentials from this sandbox — expected per agent-to-agent context note. API correctly persists client_email_sent=false, owner_email_sent=false, email_error populated.

critical_code_review_comments: email_templates.py owner row builder has a subtle quirk: when phone is empty the 'safe_phone' variable is set to '—' but the conditional 'safe_phone if not phone else <a tel link>' still uses safe_phone correctly — fine, just dense. Consider simplifying.

server.py owner_inbox defaults to SMTP_USER which is the same Gmail address (bualuangthailandspa@gmail.com) — correct per spec, but if SMTP_USER is ever swapped to a relay-only sender the admin notifications will go to that relay. Consider a dedicated OWNER_EMAIL env var for clarity.
Background task has no retry/backoff for transient SMTP failures. Acceptable for MVP — flag for production.
GET /api/contact has no pagination/auth — fine for MVP, flag for production hardening.
Hero h1 uses bg-clip-text:transparent so accessible text-rendering relies on the inner <span>; filter:drop-shadow correctly applies because it walks the painted alpha. Good fix.

Call button labels per locale: POZOVITE NAS / CALL US / ПОЗВОНИТЕ НАМ / 致电我们.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Previous test file referenced old field 'email_sent' which no longer exists in the response — updated assertions to use client_email_sent/owner_email_sent/email_error and added a wait-and-verify test for the background task outcome.
